cohort: 50 antenatal patients with premature rupture of membranes and 50 controls
finding: Escherichia coli was the most common bacterial isolate in patients with PROM.
mod_finding: 70% of the PROM group had spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD) compared to 48% of the controls, while 30% of the PROM group and 52% of the controls underwent cesarean section.
